message: Our resident **Witch** aficionados — *Raquaza*, *King Levy*, and *King Thing* — are casting spells and vanquishing foes in impressive style. We see Chanco leading the charge in donations, setting the bar at 192. Meanwhile, *JaxikoLane* is right behind with 194! To our River Race warriors: *King Levy*, *raquaza*, and *JaxikoLane* have already battled today — a massive thanks for keeping us in the race. Yet there’s room for more magic. **Neanderthal**, show us those legendary *Mini P.E.K.K.A* moves, and *thn*, unleash that *Skeleton Army*! Time to rally the troops and crush this River Race! 🏆
